hint: Tap me any time to see this tip again.

index.text: Start with News to see what Ashfaq has been up to lately.

about.text: Work experience and activities are folded into rows. Tap one to unfold the details.

education.text: Every stop from school to the MSc at the University of Surrey. The Timeline shows the bigger picture.

publications.text: Search by title or author, and tap BIB on any paper to copy its citation.

projects.text: Some projects have live demos. Package Recognizer runs on Hugging Face, so you can try it with a photo.

timeline.text: Scroll down and the line fills in, one milestone at a time.

news.text: Newest first. Each item links to the paper or page behind it.
